hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote via a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens into the Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from it, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the pool's own liquidity. Liquidity addition and donations are blocked by design.
